UPDATE sellerProfiles 
SET stripeConnectId = 'acct_1T8hMxCblQuzQFtP', 
    stripeConnectStatus = 'active'
WHERE userId = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'tearshim1004@gmail.com');

SELECT sp.userId, u.email, sp.stripeConnectId, sp.stripeConnectStatus 
FROM sellerProfiles sp 
JOIN users u ON sp.userId = u.id 
WHERE u.email = 'tearshim1004@gmail.com';
